title: QuantZing
shortDescription: Real-time social network, ZingSpaces audio rooms, and Quanty AI on ATProto.
fullDescription:
QuantZing is the sovereign real-time social network built on the open AT Protocol and powered by QuantOS.

KEY FEATURES:
- Share What's Zinging: Publish Zings, Rezing breaking updates, Quote Zing conversations, and attach high-resolution photos, video, and threads.
- Sovereign Identity: Own your portable @handle.quantzing.com or @handle.quantzing.in identity on the QuantZing Personal Data Server (PDS).
- Quanty AI: Built-in real-time intelligence to summarize threads, research market signals, and draft sharp Zings directly inside your timeline.
- ZingSpaces Live Audio: Host or join low-latency audio rooms with speakers, listeners, and instant reactions.
- QuantZing Pro & Wallet: Unlock verified creator badges, custom themes, priority feeds, and seamless creator tipping.
- True Dark OLED Design: Engineered for speed, clarity, and zero visual clutter across mobile and web.
